notes: No input mismatches Go, and no input a record lists as matched fails. 1269 inputs their records list as rejected and 42 they list as mismatched now match Go; the class options, preset matrix and trinket and enchant records, whose stale mismatches the merged fixes resolved, are refreshed from this run, as are the spell proc and mana item, gear swap, Arcane, Mage race and Enhancement Shaman sweep records whose outcomes changed.

Nine inputs their records list as mismatched are rejected: the six Arcane sweep and three Mage race sweep variants whose rows predate the rejected field while the records count them as rejected. Each is a #622 condition on an aura the character lacks.
The two errors are the pinned Go engine's panic at mage/talents_fire.go:135, Ignite on the Goblin Sapper Charge's hit, for the Arcane and Fire Mage gear swap variants with the sapper.

The 186 rejections left: 106 #622 conditions on an aura the character lacks, where the pinned reference and community fix #622 differ; 54 trinket and chest enchant auras that hear the target's swings on a tank (Uther's Strength, The Lion Horn of Stormwind, Essence of the Pure Flame, the three Absorption enchants); 12 Linken's Boomerang hardcasts on the tanking Feral Bear; 12 Smite Priest variants whose trinket or enchant changes healing power, which Holy Nova reads as fixed; 2 Demonology Warlock variants where Frozen Heart of the Mountain changes the Shadow damage Demonic Brand reads.
The sweep, preset matrix and Mage census variants were rerun from the a3dbc766d tree; main dropped them as regenerable from each record's generator.
